title: Kuldra Boss Fight! 🐉 | RuneScape Dragonwilds – God-Eater Battle
author: J4Y2G00D
description:
The fight is finally here… Kuldra, the God-Eater! 🐉🔥

Join me for the full Kuldra boss battle in RuneScape: Dragonwilds as I take on the Dragon Queen in the Scorned Wilderness.

This is the Kuldra fight itself, with the focus on the boss battle, mechanics, surviving the encounter and chasing those incredible Dragon gear rewards.

Kuldra is the end-game boss introduced with the Scorned Wilderness update, and defeating her guarantees a Dragon Kiteshield and Cape, with additional Dragon armour and weapon rewards available.

If you're enjoying RuneScape Dragonwilds, hit Like, Subscribe and let me know in the comments how your Kuldra fights have gone!
